scope: Primary official sources only for operative platform claims. No benchmarkCPC/keywordvolume claims.

sources.title: X Ads eligibility
sources.finding: Verified account programme and live representative profile URL are eligibility requirements.

sources.title: X advertising budget and promotion
sources.finding: No minimum media budget stated; spend-to-earn credit offer has separate conditions.

sources.title: X incentive terms
sources.finding: Credits have eligibility/use conditions and are not refundable cash.

sources.title: Reddit community spam rules
sources.finding: Community-specific self-promotion rules; no universal permission from a10percent heuristic.

sources.title: Meta personal attributes
sources.finding: Do not imply knowledge of sensitive personal/family attributes. You/your is allowed without such assertions.

sources.title: Create Facebook Page
sources.finding: A Facebook account manages a separate brand/business Page.

sources.title: Instagram professional accounts
sources.finding: Business fits brands; professional profiles are public and support insights/contact features.

sources.title: Avoid Apple fee on Meta boosts
sources.finding: Meta documents web/Business Suite/Ads Manager routes that avoid Apple service fees on in-app boosts.

sources.title: YouTube clickable links
sources.finding: Shorts descriptions/comments links are not clickable; long-form external links depend on advanced features.

sources.title: Product Hunt community guidelines
sources.finding: Profiles must represent individuals; vote manipulation, mass messages and incentivized votes are disallowed.

sources.title: Post a product on Product Hunt
sources.finding: Personal account and onboarding; makers can self-hunt; company accounts cannot post.

sources.title: Product Hunt before launch
sources.finding: Guide states one-week minimum for new accounts and prohibits paid hunting; exact account readiness checked at execution.

sources.title: LinkedIn Page types
sources.finding: Free Page is separate from a personal administrator profile.

sources.title: LinkedIn Page creation restrictions
sources.finding: New-account age, genuine connections, work verification and unique URL may affect creation.

sources.title: Xiaohongshu community covenant2.0
sources.finding: Transparent commercial identity, authentic content and AI disclosure guidance; official transaction tools. Live page date2026-10-13.

sources.title: Xiaohongshu Pugongying diversion rules
sources.finding: Commercial-collaboration notes restrict off-platform contacts/links and third-party-app download advertorials; ad-reviewed exception routes separate. Page updated2026-10-13; rule effective2025-10-13.

sources.title: Xiaohongshu Pugongying excluded industries
sources.finding: List includes restricted finance/privacy services; does not establish Rillora account/category approval.

sources.title: TikTok campaign/ad-group budgets
sources.finding: Campaign/ad-group minimums differ; daily ad group greater-than20USD wording; lifetime minimum depends on duration.

sources.title: TikTok profile website links
sources.finding: Consumer help states1000followers or Registered Business Account; availability varies.

sources.title: TikTok account entitlements2026
sources.finding: May2026: General/Advanced/Verified Business levels; public business profile/conversion display requires higher entitlement.

sources.title: TikTok commercial content disclosure
sources.finding: Own-business promotion also requires disclosure setting.

sources.title: TikTok commercial music
sources.finding: Ordinary music licences do not automatically cover commercial promotional use.

sources.title: Google relationship hardships personalized ads
sources.finding: Bereavement services are a sensitive category; advertiser-curated audiences restricted when that category applies.

sources.title: Google campaign total budgets
sources.finding: New Search campaigns support total budget with dates and multiple bid strategies; no daily limit; account UI still to verify.

sources.title: Google average-daily spending limits
sources.finding: Most campaigns may spend2times daily average and30.4times monthly; not a hard campaign-total cap.

sources.title: Google Presence location setting
sources.finding: Presence excludes interest-only targeting; location matching is not guaranteed100percent.

sources.title: Google Keyword Planner forecasts
sources.finding: Basic keyword tools require completed setup/billing; forecasts are estimates, not actual conversions.

sources.title: Apple Ads availability
sources.finding: App must be available in eligible App Store region to run ads.

sources.title: Apple Ads Basic vs Advanced
sources.finding: Basic CPI lacks keyword controls; Advanced supports keyword/tap-bid control and attribution capabilities.

sources.title: Bluesky domain handle
sources.finding: Existing owned domain can be a handle; domain verification is separate from visual badges.

sources.title: Pinterest business account
sources.finding: Free business account includes analytics; ad-account/country eligibility remains separate.

sources.title: LinkedIn Dynamic Group Budget
sources.finding: This specific budget mode has a30USD daily campaign minimum; old10USD documents are not universal current pricing.

retrievalNotes: Web fetches for someMeta pages returned429/login; the normal browser rendered the primary policies publicly without logging in.
Xiaohongshu about page contains2019historical audience statistics; these were deliberately not used. Pugongying policy bodies were read in the browser.
PH onboarding vs older one-week guide and TikTok consumer-vsBusiness entitlement wording are recorded as scope/rollout differences, not invented account capability.
